beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley settles into the chair, still faintly amused.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I've got a full plate this month, but let's get all three cards out — the Empress first, though. That one's been on my mind."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You set the Empress down first.

options.text: Pleasure and ease aren't indulgences — they're part of the message.
It's about saying yes to the unknown instead of playing it safe.
It's about a partnership that listens to more than one voice.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Does that mean I'm supposed to have a finished album by now?"

options.text: No — it just says something's forming, not that it has to be finished.
The Empress doesn't apply until something's fully finished.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Now the Fool — where I actually am right now, out here."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You set the Fool down next.

options.text: Standing at the edge, calm, not scared of the fall.
It's about nourishing something quietly until it's ready.
It's about weighing a choice from every angle.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "The tour's going to end eventually. What then?"

options.text: One cycle ends the instant the next one begins.
It's about holding two sides of yourself in balance.
It's about pleasure and beauty being part of the message.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "And the Lovers — the band, the choice, all of it."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You set the Lovers down last.

options.text: A real choice, weighed from every angle before you make it.
It's about trusting a path will appear once you step.
It's about abundance growing in every direction at once.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I still feel like two different people sometimes — the one from the old band, and this one."

options.text: Both are still you — the card's about holding both sides in balance.
It's about a fresh cycle starting the moment the old one ends.
It's about raw, unformed chaos that hasn't settled yet.
